verdict.rationale: Bolna's docs show only that a user can create an API key; nothing shows scopes, per-agent restrictions, or least-privilege permissions on those credentials, so this applicable capability is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented scoped or permission-limited API keys, per-agent or per-resource credential restriction, and least-privilege role controls for keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
